text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One evening, I'm wandering the<n>campus grounds
in search of Symboli<n>Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I spot her heading up the stairs to the<n>roof, a grave
expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume I raced against the<n>other day has
quit the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, after seeing my<n>performance, she felt
that she could<n>never compete.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She is not the first to feel that way. I<n>have watched
several other<n>Umamusume leave the academy
under similar circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With every spirit I have inadvertently<n>broken, I
have sworn to myself<n>anew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will do my utmost to make my racing<n>a guiding
light...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A beacon to lead the way to a brighter<n>future for
all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I cannot deny that I sometimes<n>have doubts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I seek to reach the top by climbing the<n>mountain of
victory, for the good of all<n>Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But am I truly doing that for their<n>benefit? Or simply
to satisfy my own<n>ego?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have asked myself this question<n>many times,
and every time, I have<n>concluded that my path is
just.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe that even the Umamusume I<n>hurt will
benefit from the future I hope<n>to build.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have to believe it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you think my dream is worth<n>pursuing?
choice_data_list: A little late for second thoughts, don't you think?
A little late for second thoughts, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you think my dream is worth<n>pursuing?
choice_data_list: A little late for second thoughts, don't you think?
A little late for second thoughts, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At least one of us is free of doubts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I'm simply feeling jaded<n>today.
choice_data_list: It's nice to see a different side of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I take my eyes off you for an instant,<n>and there
you go, slipping ahead of<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, shake my hand once more<n>and promise
me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Promise me you'll stay by my side as<n>I walk this
road...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And keep me straight and true.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I grasp Symboli Rudolf's hand,<n>squeeze it firmly,
and...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She smiles, just a little.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're right. I was foolish not to see<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's up to me to prove that my path is<n>correct.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've grown a little too used to leaning<n>on you, it
seems.
choice_data_list: I'm happy to be leaned on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're really too much<n>sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, shake my hand once more<n>and promise
me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Promise me you'll stay by my side as<n>I walk this
road...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And judge for yourself the leader I<n>become.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:

and...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She smiles, just a little.
